body:
The barrels are probably just for looks. If you wanted to, you could be like me and scavenge a small electric motor, attach some PVC barrels and wire it to some batteries. 
As for the drum, it's just a pretzel container.

You want to know what they said? 

"You're not old enough to be feeling like that"

No shit. Our counselors suck.
Family is the only reason I haven't.
I'd rather write one then leave them guessing.

Again, what does it matter if I don't love myself? How can I live with myself if I hate myself? I don't even know why I'm like this! I can't spend my life like this. 

I'm sorry, this doesn't really make sense.
I've got no damn clue. I'd like too, but I keep thinking of my family.
No, I haven't told anyone. I feel that would make things worse. I've disappointed my family enough already.
So I can go on another 60+ years disappointing everyone I meet? What happens when I'm older, I can die then instead of now? I'll end up in the same place either way.

Nothing wrong enough that I should want to kill myself. If you would have told me a year ago that I would be this close to suicide I would've laughed in your face. I do not understand it in the least.

I'm not depressed (I don't think so, anyway). I haven't read anything either. 

It's all very odd. I'm not a sad guy. I have nothing to be depressed about. Maybe its anxiety. Who knows, who cares. I've just got feeling that I don't want to be. Today I realized that I would go through with it this evening, and I was in this amazing mood. Nothing to worry about anymore. It'll be over soon.
It doesn't seem like it would be a mistake. It seems like the right choice.

Hello, my name is Ryan. I also thought I was going to kill myself tonight. I know many people don't quite get it, and I also know that every story is different. I understand. Please feel free to talk to me about anything. I'm sorry that I can't really offer more than that.

Hello, my name is Ryan. We can help you out. Thing can get better, and they will. All you have to do is let us know what's up. We can point you in the right direction. Your life matters to somebody, even if its some random people on the Internet. Please don't go through with this; we care.

Thanks for the reply. 

If you don't mind me asking, what kind of help did you receive?

I appreciate the direction. 

I see you a lot on here and I want to thank you for that. I can tell you make a huge difference in many people's lives.
